eligibility_outcome_blind: eligibility adjudicated from registry/metadata properties only; no ORION predictions, baselines or protected outcomes exist at this stage

eligibility_rules.E_COMMON_PROVENANCE_BOUND: content_binding_provenance matches the census-bound route for the stratum
eligibility_rules.E_COMMON_STRATUM_MATCH: row stratum equals the frozen census manifest stratum
eligibility_rules.E_COMMON_TRANSITION_DIGESTS_HEX64: before_sha256 and after_sha256 are lowercase 64-hex digests
eligibility_rules.E_S1_LICENSES_PRESENT: stratum 1: license_before and license_after both nonempty (open-licensed transition)
eligibility_rules.E_S2_LICENSES_PRESENT: stratum 2: license_before and license_after both nonempty
eligibility_rules.E_S2_REUSE_FRAME_BOUND: stratum 2: A3-reuse rows carry the frozen successor frame sha256 recorded by the census manifest
eligibility_rules.E_S3_SUPPLEMENT_TYPE_DATASET: stratum 3: supplement_resource_type_general == Dataset (the mechanically bound sub-route; software-side supplements are a recorded CANNOT_CHECK class and are not eligible)

receipt_semantics.adjudicator_assignment_receipt_id: stages the packet into the frozen external adjudicator handoff queue; confers no authority and records no adjudication
receipt_semantics.candidate_visible_packet_sha256: SHA-256 over the canonical candidate-visible payload (target-relevant scientific coordinates + terminal alphabet only)
receipt_semantics.external_custody_receipt_id: binds the transition bytes to the external source coordinates holding them; a custody statement, not a sign-off
